runtimeStubs.description: Mount the actual App.svelte/MobileApp with fixture-controlled conversation state and blocked gateway/network access. Browser setup seeds the open snapshot and initial MESSAGE_PAGE window directly; this does not exercise the real open transport.

anchorBoxToleranceNote: Capture actual before/after boxes and retain per-tuple measured deltas. Initial 390px light scale-1 smoke runs observed 2px shifts with sign varying between renderers/runs; this bound does not imply exact cross-client anchoring.
